name: AllUnity EUR
oneLiner: EURAU is AllUnity's MiCA-licensed euro stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 against EUR held in full-reserve, segregated accounts at EU credit institutions.
collateral: Euro-denominated reserves held at CRR credit institutions within the EU, under a multi-bank full reserve model; not used for lending or investment
